ledger.claim: The governing distance is the trace, not the rounded trip record: gps_trace.trace_distance_km is 23.97 km against a booked optimal of 18.0 km, an excess of 5.97 km — 33.17% of optimal. The rider's '6 km' is his own estimate; the measured excess is 5.97 km and the claim is made at that figure, which is the field POL-RD-01 makes governing where the trace and trip_record.actual_distance_km disagree.

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08(a) and has discharged it: trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry TRP-00114, and limb (b) is met by the 5.97 km excess measured from an unimpaired trace. The burden therefore shifts to the driver, who must point to a specific artifact and a specific clause to invoke POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05, POL-RD-11 or POL-RD-12. His counterparty statement points to none, and POL-RD-08 provides that a general assertion that traffic was bad, unsupported by a traffic_advisory ID, does not discharge that burden.

The only relevant chat traffic is the rider asking at 18:58:40 'adam road?? jurong is the other way' — a query sent 18 minutes into the trip, and the driver replying 'AYE jam boss, this way faster'. Nothing in the chat_log asks for a detour, and waypoint_hint is null on both messages, so there is no waypoint to test against the 200 m radius and no road is named for the rider. POL-RD-04 is unavailable on this record and no distance is excluded under it.

EV-ADVIS-00114-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — I disclose that impairment, and I cite it for no fact other than its own absence. Under POL-RD-13 the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion 'AYE was crawling from the Alexandra exit' carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The deviation therefore stands at the measured figure and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal route, with no amended optimal supplied by the driver or derivable from the record.

That is 23.5% of the charge, above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and far below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND. ruling.explanation:
Both sides agree on the arithmetic, and the record supports it. Measured on the GPS polyline (23.97 km, EV-GPS-00114), which POL-RD-01 makes governing over the rounded trip-record copy, the route exceeded the booked optimal of 18.0 km (EV-TRIP-00114) by 5.97 km, or 33.17%. That clears both establishment limbs (over 20% and over 0.8 km), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED; it clears neither materiality limb (50% or 8.0 km), so POL-RD-06's full-refund uplift and its conduct referral are not engaged. On the driver's side, even if POL-RD-06 were consulted, the permitted fields show 1 deviation flag over 412 completed trips (EV-DPROF-00114), far below the 3-flag or 0.05-ratio pattern test, so no pattern exists. No exoneration applies. POL-RD-03 needs a traffic advisory and none exists: EV-ADVIS-00114-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run, and under POL-RD-13 the driver's congestion explanation ('AYE was crawling from the Alexandra exit'), which names no advisory identifier, carries no weight; the deviation stands at the measured figure against the booked optimal route. POL-RD-04 fails because the chat log (EV-CHAT-00114) records a rider query ('adam road?? jurong is the other way') and not a rider instruction, and both messages carry a null waypoint_hint; POL-RD-05, POL-RD-11 and POL-RD-12 do not apply on this trip record. The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02 on the METERED fare model: ((3.80 + 0.75 x 18.0 + 0.28 x 30.0) x 1.6, the surge read from EV-FARE-00114) + 0.80 platform fee + 2.50 of on-optimal-route ERP = 44.42. Charged total 58.10 less 44.42 = 13.68, rounded up to 13.70. That is above the 0.50 de-minimis floor and 23.5% of the charge, well below the 90% full-refund share, so this is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 13.70 - not the 15.00 contended and not a full refund. The SGD 2.00 Adam Road gantry (EV-FARE-00114) is the only off-route ERP line and is already comprehended inside the recomputation, so it is itemised for transparency but never added on top; the SGD 2.50 Kim Keat Link gantry lies on the optimal route and is properly chargeable. The 1.6 surge is applied as the rider accepted. No escalation trigger fired: the trace is unimpaired for policy purposes (100% coverage, 10 s interval, no gaps, max gap 0), the trip identifiers match across the artifacts, both billed gantries match the trace within the 250 m radius (nearest fixes at 0.0 m and 8.76 m), and the refund is far below SGD 150.00. Confidence is 0.95, well above the 0.70 floor, and is capped at 1.0 by the weight-1.0 artifacts that carry the deciding facts (EV-GPS-00114, EV-TRIP-00114, EV-FARE-00114). Because the SGD 13.70 exceeds the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, the amount is issued but held for release under POL-GEN-05. Open point for the human reviewer: the platform holds no LTA advisory for the AYE/PIE/Alexandra corridor in the trip window, so the driver's congestion claim is untested rather than disproved.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
